enchantments.tooltip: +3 Enhancement Bonus: +3 enhancement bonus to attack and damage rolls.

Shattermantle: Transluscent, writhing energy and blue sparks can be seen raging within this weapon. When a shattermantle weapon strikes a foe that has spell resistance, the value of that spell resistance is reduced by 3 for 9 seconds. A foe can only have its SR reduced by one Shattermantle effect at a time.
Bewildering 1: This weapon saps the willpower and sense from your enemies, dealing 1 Wisdom damage on each hit.
Mythic Weapon Boost +2 or +4: +2 or +4 Mythic bonus to Melee, Ranged, and Universal Spell Power.(This is a rare enchantment that does not show up on all drops of this item.)
